rows.grounds: fused instrumental vāgīśvareṇa plus accusative feminine participle sahitām; internal sandhi not split
fused instrumental plural upacārais plus anukramāt; internal sandhi not split

items.question: Should worship proceed with Vāgīśvara accompanied and upacāras performed in order?
items.inference: The verse prescribes ordered upacāra worship with Vāgīśvara.
uncertainties: Exact grammatical relation of the fused token remains editorially unresolved.
items.plain_english: Worship with Vāgīśvara, offering the upacāras in order.
